strategy.summary: The todo app (static files served by server.js, all state in the browser) lets users tick todos complete, filter All/Active/Completed and clear completed todos. Playwright e2e tests against the real app must prove the strike-through and items-left count follow the checkbox both ways, each filter shows exactly the right todos and is the only one pressed, and "Clear completed" shows only while a todo is completed and removes all completed todos.
inScope: Completing and un-completing a todo via its checkbox (strike-through, items left count)
All / Active / Completed filters and their aria-pressed state
Visibility and effect of the Clear completed button
outOfScope: Adding todos (covered by the existing add-todo spec, used here only as setup)
Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos in memory only; the ticket doesn't ask for it)
assumptions: The real app runs: Playwright's existing webServer starts `node server.js`; nothing is faked. Todos live in page memory, so each test starts from an empty list and creates its own todos through the UI, with no shared state between tests.
"Struck through" is checked as the todo text's computed text-decoration-line being line-through (styles.css applies it to li.completed span), and not struck through when active.
The app has no action this ticket covers that it can refuse; the negative cases are the reverse/absent states (unticking, Clear completed hidden when nothing is completed, filters excluding todos).

risks.description: Count or strike-through not reverting when a todo is unticked
risks.mitigation: TC2 unticks and checks both revert

risks.description: A filter showing the wrong set, or more than one filter appearing pressed
risks.mitigation: TC3-TC5 assert the exact list and the aria-pressed state of all three buttons

risks.description: Clear completed removing only the first completed todo, or active todos, or staying visible
risks.mitigation: TC7 completes two of three todos and asserts the exact remaining list and that the button hides

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed: it is struck through and the items-left count goes down by one; unticking reverses both.
Active shows only todos not completed, Completed only completed ones, All shows every todo; the selected filter is shown as pressed.
"Clear completed" is shown only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decrements items left
preconditions: Fresh page with todos 'Buy milk' and 'Walk dog' added
steps: Check that '2 items left' shows and 'Buy milk' is not struck through
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox is checked and its text is line-through; 'Walk dog' is not; count reads '1 item left'

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores items left
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk' and 'Walk dog' added, 'Buy milk' ticked ('1 item left')
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, text not line-through, count reads '2 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only todos that are not completed and is pressed
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent' added; 'Walk dog' ticked
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Buy milk', 'Pay rent']; Active aria-pressed=true, All and Completed false
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is pressed
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent' added; 'Walk dog' ticked
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog']; Completed aria-pressed=true, All and Active false
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again and is pressed
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent' added; 'Walk dog' ticked; Completed filter selected
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent']; All aria-pressed=true, Active and Completed false
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent
testCases.rationale: Returning to All restores the full list

testCases.title: Clear completed is shown only while a todo is completed
testCases.expected: Hidden before ticking, visible after ticking, hidden again after unticking

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps the active ones
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent' added; 'Buy milk' and 'Pay rent' ticked
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog']; count '1 item left'; Clear completed hidden
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent
testCases.rationale: Removes all, not just one, completed todos

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright config's webServer starts `node server.js` on port 4173 (BASE_URL http://localhost:4173). No env vars, seed data or backend.
